title: View a specific file metadata attribute
summary: Use mdls with the -name flag to retrieve only one specific piece of metadata about a file, such as its creation date or pixel dimensions, instead of the full list.

steps.explain: Use the -name flag followed by the attribute key (e.g., kMDItemFSCreationDate) and the file path to show only that attribute.

placeholders.name: ATTRIBUTE
placeholders.description: The specific metadata attribute key to retrieve (e.g., kMDItemFSCreationDate, kMDItemPixelWidth).

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: The path to the file you want to inspect.
